8cd51d8df0059a069a695b5b2af1e5d53e489c41.sourceText:
| 写法 | 说明 | 注意事项 |
|:---|:---|:---|
| `_1` | 调用新函数时传入的第一个参数 | 来自 `std::placeholders` |
| `_2` | 调用新函数时传入的第二个参数 | 可以用来调整顺序 |
| 固定值 | 直接写在 `bind` 参数里 | 默认会被拷贝保存 |
| `&Class::method` | 成员函数指针 | 后面还要绑定对象 |
| `this` | 成员函数内部的当前对象指针 | 常作为绑定成员函数时的第二个参数 |
| `std::ref(x)` | 按引用绑定 `x` | 不写 `std::ref` 通常会拷贝 |
8cd51d8df0059a069a695b5b2af1e5d53e489c41.translatedText:
| Syntax | Description | Notes |
|:---|:---|:---|
| `_1` | The first parameter passed when calling a new function | From `std::placeholders` |
| `_2` | The second parameter passed when calling a new function | Can be used to adjust the order |
| Fixed value | Written directly in `bind` parameter | By default, it is copied and saved |
| `&Class::method` | Member function pointer | An object still needs to be bound afterward |
| `this` | The current object pointer inside a member function | Often used as the second parameter when binding a member function |
| `std::ref(x)` | Bind by reference `x` | If not written, `std::ref` is usually copied |
